posts.title: Dashboard writing MVP
posts.body_markdown:
# Dashboard writing MVP

A read-only Blog / Drafts surface for keeping writing ideas visible inside the private dashboard without wiring in the old backoffice stack.

## Deferred write work

Create, edit, publish, delete, and attachment upload stay deferred until storage, backup, path allowlisting, and publishing semantics are reviewed.

posts.title: Safe import notes from old personal backoffice
posts.body_markdown:
# Safe import notes

Useful UI ideas: post cards, tags, draft/published badges, selected-post preview, and attachment metadata. Unsafe imports rejected: old auth client, GraphQL localhost calls, Mongo counters, and remote file upload/delete plumbing.
